title: The Blue Line Cafe
author: Barış Kısır
premise: When chef Emi Tanaka returns to her hometown to save her mother's cafe, she finds the man she left at eighteen — Liam, now the cafe's morning baker — still making the same cinnamon rolls, and still angry. Over one summer, they must decide whether a decade of silence is a recipe they can break.
short_description: Emi, a Chicago sous-chef, returns to Port Meridian to help her mother Rosa, who has Parkinson's.
long_description: Emi, a Chicago sous-chef, returns to Port Meridian to help her mother Rosa, who has Parkinson's. Liam, the morning baker, is furious she left and plans to sell. An intercepted letter, a summer of brunch service, and Rosa's decline force Emi to choose between the Chicago job and the cafe — and Liam.
main_characters: Emi Tanaka — driven, wounded, brilliant chef
Liam O'Brien — steady, funny, buried grief
June — Emi's best friend, cafe regular
Marcus — the Chicago mentor, a temptation
